metadata.name: raffles
metadata.description: PiggyGang Raffles: escrowed prizes, free per-NFT entries and a Switchboard VRF draw

instructions.name: accept_authority
docs: Makes the proposed authority the config's authority. It has to sign.

accounts.name: new_authority
docs: The pending authority. Its signature is the proof that it can sign at
all, which is what the transfer waits for.

instructions.name: init_config
docs: Creates `Config` with `settings`. Only the program's upgrade authority
can, and it becomes the config's authority.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The program's upgrade authority. It pays `Config`'s rent and becomes
its authority.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: Where the upgradeable loader keeps the program's upgrade authority,
which the signer has to be.

instructions.name: set_authority
docs: Proposes `new_authority` as the config's authority, in place of any
earlier proposal. The zero address withdraws the proposal. The
authority doesn't change until `new_authority` signs
`accept_authority`.

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Changes the settings that `update` names, the pause flag among them,
and leaves the others as they are. A raffle keeps the settings it
copied when it was created.

errors.name: InvalidRuleKind
errors.msg: not a membership rule kind the program knows

errors.name: InvalidPrizeKind
errors.msg: not a prize kind the program knows

errors.name: InvalidEscrowKind
errors.msg: not an escrow kind the program knows

errors.name: InvalidRaffleState
errors.msg: not a raffle state the program knows

errors.name: InvalidCancelReason
errors.msg: not a cancel reason the program knows

errors.name: InvalidTransition
errors.msg: the raffle can't move to that state from the one it is in

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: the signer isn't the authority this instruction takes

errors.name: InvalidInitializer
errors.msg: the signer isn't the program's upgrade authority

errors.name: InvalidEntryCap
errors.msg: the entry cap isn't between 1 and the highest the program allows

errors.name: InvalidFullGangBonus
errors.msg: the entry cap and the Full Gang bonus don't fit one entry range

errors.name: InvalidDurationBounds
errors.msg: the shortest duration is zero, or longer than the longest

errors.name: InvalidRuleAddress
errors.msg: a membership rule's address is zero

errors.name: InvalidRuleUpdateAuthority
errors.msg: a membership rule's update authority doesn't fit its kind

errors.name: InvalidRuleSymbol
errors.msg: a membership rule's symbol doesn't fit its kind

errors.name: DuplicateMembershipRule
errors.msg: two membership rules are the same

types.name: AuthorityAccepted
docs: `accept_authority` completed the transfer: `new_authority` signed, and is
`Config::authority` from here on.

types.name: AuthorityProposed
docs: `set_authority` named the authority's successor, or withdrew one: then
`pending_authority` is zero. `authority` stays in charge either way.

types.name: Config
docs: The program's settings: one account, at `[CONFIG_SEED]`, that `init_config`
creates and nothing closes.
A raffle copies the rules, the cap, the bonus and the duration bounds when
it is created (spec D14), so an edit here reaches only later raffles. The
authority and `paused` are the only fields read live.

fields.name: authority
docs: The admin. On mainnet the Squads vault, never the multisig account
(registries §6). It creates raffles without a `CreatorEntry`.

fields.name: pending_authority
docs: Set by `set_authority`; becomes `authority` once it signs
`accept_authority`. Zero when no transfer is pending.

fields.name: paused
docs: Blocks `create_raffle`, `claim_entries` and `request_draw`. Nothing
that pays out a prize or returns rent reads it (spec §10).

fields.name: membership_rules
docs: One rule per Piggy collection. Rule `i` is bit `i` of
`EntryPosition::collections_seen`.

fields.name: entry_cap
docs: Per-NFT entries one wallet may claim in a raffle, 1 to
`MAX_ENTRY_CAP`. A raffle may lower it for itself (spec D6).

fields.name: full_gang_bonus
docs: Entries the Full Gang bonus adds, on top of the cap. Together with the
cap it has to fit `EntryRange::count`.

fields.name: min_duration
docs: The shortest raffle, in seconds.

fields.name: max_duration
docs: The longest raffle, in seconds.

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Zero. Room for a later setting without a realloc.

types.name: ConfigInitialized
docs: `init_config` created `Config`. The fields after `authority` are the
settings it starts with.

types.name: ConfigSettings
docs: What the authority sets in `Config`: `init_config` takes all of it, and
both config events carry all of it.

fields.name: paused
docs: Whether the program starts, or is, paused.

fields.name: membership_rules
docs: One rule per Piggy collection, each valid and no two the same.

fields.name: entry_cap
docs: 1 to `MAX_ENTRY_CAP`.

fields.name: full_gang_bonus
docs: With `entry_cap`, at most 255.

fields.name: min_duration
docs: Seconds, above zero.

fields.name: max_duration
docs: Seconds, at least `min_duration`.

types.name: ConfigUpdate
docs: What `update_config` changes: the settings it names, and no other. A
proposal can wait for its signatures while another one lands, so an update
that carried every setting would undo whatever changed in between. This
one can't: a pause names the pause flag and leaves the rest as it finds it.

fields.name: membership_rules
docs: All three rules, or none: they are checked as a set.

types.name: ConfigUpdated
docs: `update_config` changed a setting, the pause flag included. The event
carries every setting, changed or not: the difference from the event
before it is the change. An update that changed nothing emits it too.

types.name: CreatorAdded
docs: `creator_add` created the wallet's `CreatorEntry`.

types.name: CreatorRemoved
docs: `creator_remove` closed the wallet's `CreatorEntry`.

types.name: DrawRequested
docs: `request_draw` requested randomness: the first request, which moves the
raffle to Drawing, or a later one after the retry timeout.

fields.name: total_entries
docs: The entries the draw picks from. They are final from the first
request on.

fields.name: draw_requested_at
docs: Cluster time of the first request, the same in every later one.

fields.name: vrf_requests
docs: Requests so far, this one included: 1 for the first.

fields.name: vrf_request
docs: The VRF provider's request account for `vrf_seed`: where the
randomness and its proof will be.

types.name: EntriesClaimed
docs: `claim_entries` entered `nfts` for `wallet`.

fields.name: range
docs: The entries this claim added, the bonus included, as the range it
appended to the wallet's position. A `count` of zero says it added
none and appended nothing: a pig at the cap that only adds a
collection.

fields.name: bonus_entries
docs: How many of the range's entries are the Full Gang bonus: zero unless
this claim completed the set.

fields.name: nfts
docs: The NFTs entered, in the order the claim gave them: a Token Metadata
mint or a Core asset each, and one new `EntryReceipt` each.

types.name: EntryAccountsClosed
docs: `close_entry_accounts` closed entry accounts and returned their rent to
the wallets that paid it.

fields.name: wallets
docs: The wallets whose `EntryPosition` was closed.

fields.name: nfts
docs: The NFTs whose `EntryReceipt` was closed.

types.name: EntryRange
docs: A run of consecutive entry indexes that one claim added.

fields.name: start
docs: The first index: `Raffle::total_entries` when the claim ran.

fields.name: count
docs: How many entries: at most the cap plus the Full Gang bonus.

types.name: MembershipRule
docs: The test that makes an NFT a Piggy of one collection (spec D19).
A flat record of 75 bytes rather than a Rust enum, whose Borsh size would
vary: `Config` and every `Raffle` hold three, and stay fixed-size.

fields.name: kind
docs: A [`RuleKind`].

fields.name: address
docs: `TmCreator`: the verified creator. `CoreCollection`: the collection.

fields.name: update_authority
docs: `TmCreator`: the metadata update authority. `CoreCollection`: zero.

fields.name: symbol
docs: `TmCreator`: the symbol, padded with zero bytes. `CoreCollection`:
zero.

types.name: PrizeAllowlisted
docs: `allowlist_add` created the `PrizeEntry` for `kind` and `address`.

fields.name: kind
docs: A `PrizeKind`.

types.name: PrizeClaimed
docs: `claim_prize` paid the prize to the winner: the raffle is Settled.

fields.name: amount
docs: Base units paid out, which is all the escrow held: at least
`Raffle::prize_amount`. 1 for a Core asset.

types.name: PrizeDelisted
docs: `allowlist_remove` closed the `PrizeEntry` for `kind` and `address`.

fields.name: kind
docs: A `PrizeKind`.

types.name: PrizeReclaimed
docs: `reclaim_prize` returned the prize to the creator.

fields.name: caller
docs: Signed the instruction. Anyone may: the prize goes to `creator`
whoever calls.

fields.name: state
docs: A `RaffleState`: Settled, or Cancelled
for the prize of a cancelled raffle, whose state the reclaim leaves
alone.

fields.name: amount
docs: Base units returned, which is all the escrow held. 1 for a Core
asset.

types.name: RaffleCancelled
docs: `cancel_raffle` cancelled the raffle: its entries are void.

fields.name: cancel_reason
docs: A `CancelReason`, never `NotCancelled`.

types.name: RaffleClosed
docs: `close_raffle` closed the Raffle, its draw-fee vault and its token escrow.
Its address is free again: a later `RaffleCreated` there is another
raffle.

types.name: RaffleCreated
docs: `create_raffle` created the raffle and escrowed its prize. The event is
everything about the raffle that never changes, so its history can be
read after `close_raffle` has removed the account.

fields.name: created_by_authority
docs: The creator signed as `Config::authority`, which needs no
`CreatorEntry`. Otherwise its entry admitted it.

fields.name: escrow_kind
docs: An `EscrowKind`.

fields.name: allowlist_kind
docs: The `PrizeKind` of the `PrizeEntry` that
admitted the prize.

fields.name: allowlist_address
docs: That entry's `address`: the collection, or the mint itself.

fields.name: description
docs: The organizer's free text. The Raffle doesn't keep it: this event and
the instruction's data are where it is on-chain.

types.name: WinnerDrawn
docs: The randomness arrived and the winner is recorded: the raffle is Drawn.

fields.name: total_entries
docs: What `winner_index` was drawn below.

fields.name: vrf_request
docs: The request account the randomness was read from.

constants.name: BREAK_GLASS_DELAY_SECS
docs: How long a raffle has to sit in Drawing before the admin may cancel it,
counted from `Raffle::draw_requested_at` (spec D15, E-D5).

constants.name: CLAIM_WINDOW_SECS
docs: How long the winner has to claim the prize, counted from
`Raffle::drawn_at` (spec D5).

constants.name: CLOSE_GRACE_SECS
docs: How long after the claim window a Drawn raffle's entry accounts become
closeable, whatever happened to the prize (spec E-S8).

constants.name: CONFIG_SEED
docs: `Config`, the singleton: `[CONFIG_SEED]`.

constants.name: CREATOR_SEED
docs: A `CreatorEntry`: `[CREATOR_SEED, wallet]`.

constants.name: FULL_GANG
docs: `EntryPosition::collections_seen` once an NFT of every membership rule is
entered: the Full Gang set.

constants.name: MAX_ENTRY_CAP
docs: The highest per-wallet entry cap `Config` may hold; spec D1 sets 10. An
`EntryPosition` is sized for it, so a higher cap needs a program upgrade.

constants.name: MAX_RULES_URI_LEN
docs: The longest `Raffle::rules_uri`, in bytes (rules design §3).

constants.name: MAX_TITLE_LEN
docs: The longest `Raffle::title`, in bytes.

constants.name: POSITION_SEED
docs: An `EntryPosition`: `[POSITION_SEED, raffle, wallet]`.

constants.name: PRIZE_SEED
docs: A `PrizeEntry`: `[PRIZE_SEED, [kind], address]`.

constants.name: RAFFLE_SEED
docs: A `Raffle`: `[RAFFLE_SEED, creator, nonce]`, the nonce as a little-endian

constants.name: RECEIPT_SEED
docs: An `EntryReceipt`: `[RECEIPT_SEED, raffle, nft]`, the NFT being a Token
Metadata mint or a Core asset.

constants.name: VAULT_SEED
docs: A raffle's draw-fee vault, a system account without data:
`[VAULT_SEED, raffle]`.
